cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Please drop the request for a private tea queue. Everyone at the fete uses this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent. Can't that count for something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It does. Your name's on the thank-you board beside the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can read it behind that urn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the urn. You can accept everyone's thanks while you wait your turn.
